lines.t: Your nation’s heart has hardened, gone the way of the wicked and heathen,
The churches of men still cry out, but their voices ring hollow and beaten.
Sodom’s shadows rise again, their fires burn within your borders,
And I look upon this land of grief, still holding back My orders.
For the sake of the chosen few, I linger in the silence,
Holding back the storm, restraining holy violence.
O mighty nation, can you hear the thunder’s warning cry?
You were blessed beyond the stars, now your glory starts to die.
I am against you, cries the Lord of sorrow and flame,
Your altars draped in blasphemy, you’ve forgotten His name.
I made you strong, I gave you light, blessings beyond compare,
Yet you bowed to gold and pride, your praises filled with despair.
The Lamb was beaten, mocked, and torn—crucified to save your soul,
But now His blood is trampled down, your darkness takes its toll.
Desecration, blasphemy—echoes through your streets,
His mercy still restrains the wrath that justice longs to meet.
How the heavens weep for you, a harlot clothed in shame,
The trumpet waits in silence, to call the elect by name.
O mighty nation, crumble to your knees and see,
The tears of heaven falling for lost eternity.
For I am against you, yet My hand still holds the day,
Until the chosen rise and the faithful are taken away.
Your nation’s heart has fallen, your glory turned to dust,
The Word of the Lord stands forever…
And He remembers those who trust.
